rationale: With only 26 minutes to close and forced liquidation at market, the risk/reward is unfavorable: KSS has already gapped up ~4.6% and run to 84.5% of its intraday range near the session high, leaving limited upside before resistance at $25.30 and meaningful downside if momentum fades into the close.
